_comment: Production queue for the Cinematic Curiosities channel. status: queued -> scripted -> rendered -> packaged -> published. Claude pulls the next 'queued' item each run.
cta: Follow for one new wonder a day.

videos.topic: What's at the bottom of the ocean's deepest point?
videos.angle: Descent POV to the Mariana Trench
videos.title: What's at the Bottom of the Ocean's Deepest Point?
videos.description: The Challenger Deep is the lowest point on Earth — and we know less about it than the Moon. Here's what's down there. 🌊 New wonder every day.
videos.thumbnail: Vertical god-ray descent into black water; text "7 MILES DOWN" in cyan.

videos.topic: Why don't we feel the Earth spinning?
videos.title: Why Don't We Feel the Earth Spinning?
videos.description: You're moving faster than a bullet right now and don't feel a thing. Here's why. 🌍 New wonder every day.
videos.thumbnail: Earth with motion-blur streaks; text "1,000 MPH."

videos.topic: What would happen if you fell into a black hole?
videos.title: What Happens If You Fall Into a Black Hole?
videos.description: Spaghettification is real — and time itself breaks down at the edge. The physics of falling in. 🕳️ New wonder every day.
videos.thumbnail: Figure stretching into a glowing accretion disk; text "SPAGHETTIFIED."

videos.topic: The library that survived 2,000 years
videos.title: The Library a Volcano Saved for 2,000 Years
videos.description: Vesuvius should have destroyed these scrolls. Instead it preserved them — and AI is finally reading them. 📜 New wonder every day.
videos.thumbnail: Charred scroll glowing with revealed text; "UNREADABLE FOR 2,000 YEARS."

videos.topic: Why is the night sky dark? (Olbers' paradox)
videos.title: Why Is the Night Sky Dark?
videos.description: Olbers' paradox: an infinite universe should make the night blinding. The darkness reveals something profound. 🌌 New wonder every day.
videos.thumbnail: Split sky, half blazing with stars half black; "WHY IS IT DARK?"

videos.topic: What's inside the Great Pyramid we still can't reach?
videos.title: The Hidden Room Inside the Great Pyramid
videos.description: Cosmic rays revealed a giant void inside the Great Pyramid in 2017 — and we still can't get in. 🔺 New wonder every day.
videos.thumbnail: Pyramid cross-section with a glowing sealed void; "WHAT'S INSIDE?"

videos.topic: How do deep-sea creatures glow?
videos.title: Why Does the Deep Sea Glow?
videos.description: Most animals on Earth make their own light — and they live in the dark ocean below us. ✨ New wonder every day.
videos.thumbnail: Glowing anglerfish lure in pitch black; "THEY MAKE LIGHT."

videos.topic: The sound that no one can explain (The Bloop)
videos.title: The Mysterious Sound From the Deep Ocean
videos.description: "The Bloop" was louder than any animal alive. For years, no one could explain it. 🔊 New wonder every day.
videos.thumbnail: Dark sonar waveform spiking; "TOO LOUD TO BE AN ANIMAL."

videos.topic: What does Earth look like from the edge of the solar system?
videos.title: What Earth Looks Like From 4 Billion Miles Away
videos.description: The "Pale Blue Dot" — everyone who ever lived, on a single pixel. 🌍 New wonder every day.
videos.thumbnail: Tiny dot in a sunbeam, arrow pointing; "THAT'S US."

videos.topic: Why do we dream?
videos.title: Why Do We Dream?
videos.description: You'll spend ~6 years of your life dreaming — and science still can't fully explain why. 💤 New wonder every day.
videos.thumbnail: Surreal floating bedroom in starscape; "6 YEARS DREAMING."

videos.topic: The city that vanished overnight
videos.title: The Ancient City That Was Abandoned Overnight
videos.description: Thriving one generation, swallowed by jungle the next. What happened to the Maya cities? 🏛️ New wonder every day.
videos.thumbnail: Jungle reclaiming a stone pyramid; "ABANDONED."

videos.topic: What's the loneliest place on Earth?
videos.title: The Loneliest Place on Earth
videos.description: At Point Nemo, the nearest humans are usually in space. It's where spacecraft go to die. 🌊 New wonder every day.
videos.thumbnail: Empty ocean with ISS overhead; "NEAREST HUMANS: IN SPACE."

videos.topic: How big is the universe, really?
videos.title: How Big Is the Universe, Really?
videos.description: Two trillion galaxies. 93 billion light-years across. Your brain isn't built for this. 🌌 New wonder every day.
videos.thumbnail: Zoom-out from Earth to cosmic web; "TWO TRILLION GALAXIES."

videos.topic: The animal that doesn't age
videos.title: The Animal That Never Has to Age
videos.description: The "immortal jellyfish" can reset its own body and start life over. Here's how. 🪼 New wonder every day.
videos.thumbnail: Glowing jellyfish with a loop arrow; "IT NEVER AGES."

videos.topic: What's hiding under Antarctica's ice?
videos.title: What's Hiding Under Antarctica's Ice?
videos.description: Hidden lakes sealed for millions of years — and they're not empty. 🧊 New wonder every day.
videos.thumbnail: Cross-section of ice over a dark lake; "SEALED FOR MILLIONS OF YEARS."

videos.topic: Why does time slow down near a black hole?
videos.title: Why Time Slows Down Near a Black Hole
videos.description: Gravity bends time itself. An hour near a black hole could be years on Earth — and it's real. ⏳ New wonder every day.
videos.thumbnail: Two clocks, one warped near a black hole; "TIME BENDS."

videos.topic: The message we sent to aliens in 1977
videos.title: The Message Humanity Sent to Aliens
videos.description: A golden record with a map to Earth is flying through interstellar space right now. 🛸 New wonder every day.
videos.thumbnail: Golden record glinting in deep space; "A MAP TO EARTH."

videos.topic: What would the last day on Earth look like?
videos.title: What the Last Day on Earth Will Look Like
videos.description: In ~5 billion years, the Sun will swell into a red giant and swallow the Earth. ☀️ New wonder every day.
videos.thumbnail: Huge red Sun looming over a scorched Earth; "THE FINAL DAY."

videos.topic: How do octopuses think?
videos.title: How Does an Octopus Think?
videos.description: Nine brains, eight arms that think for themselves. The octopus is the closest thing to alien intelligence on Earth. 🐙 New wonder every day.
videos.thumbnail: Octopus eye close-up, glowing neurons in arms; "9 BRAINS."

videos.topic: The lost color humans can no longer see
videos.title: The Colors Humans Can't See
videos.description: Some people see millions more colors than you. And "impossible colors" may exist just past your vision. 🌈 New wonder every day.
videos.thumbnail: Spectrum with a glowing "forbidden" band; "THE COLOR YOU CAN'T SEE."

videos.topic: What's the oldest living thing on Earth?
videos.title: The Oldest Living Thing on Earth
videos.description: This tree was alive before the pyramids. It's nearly 5,000 years old. 🌲 New wonder every day.
videos.thumbnail: Gnarled ancient pine on a ridge; "5,000 YEARS OLD."

videos.topic: Why is space silent?
videos.title: Why Is Space Completely Silent?
videos.description: A supernova right beside you would make no sound at all. Here's why space is silent. 🔇 New wonder every day.
videos.thumbnail: Silent explosion in space, muted symbol; "NO SOUND IN SPACE."

videos.topic: The door that's been sealed for 1,000 years
videos.title: The Sealed Doors We Were Warned Not to Open
videos.description: Ancient tombs sealed for 1,000+ years — some with curses carved above them. What's really inside? ⚰️ New wonder every day.
videos.thumbnail: Torch-lit sealed stone door with carvings; "SEALED FOR 1,000 YEARS."

videos.topic: What happens to your body in deep space?
videos.title: What Space Does to the Human Body
videos.description: You wouldn't explode in the vacuum of space — what actually happens is far stranger. 🚀 New wonder every day.
videos.thumbnail: Astronaut without helmet, 15-second countdown; "15 SECONDS."

videos.topic: The river that flows under the ocean
videos.title: The Rivers That Flow Under the Ocean
videos.description: Underwater rivers with banks and waterfalls really exist on the seafloor. 🌊 New wonder every day.
videos.thumbnail: Misty "river" flowing on the seafloor; "A RIVER UNDERWATER."

videos.topic: Why do we have fingerprints?
videos.title: Why Do We Have Fingerprints?
videos.description: It's not really about grip. The reason you have fingerprints is stranger than you think. 👆 New wonder every day.
videos.thumbnail: Macro fingerprint ridges glowing; "NOT FOR GRIP."

videos.topic: What's the brightest thing in the universe?
videos.title: The Brightest Object in the Universe
videos.description: Quasars shine like trillions of suns — powered by the one thing that traps light. 💡 New wonder every day.
videos.thumbnail: Blazing quasar jet from a galaxy core; "BRIGHT AS A TRILLION SUNS."

videos.topic: The map that predicted a place before it was found
videos.title: The Map That Knew Too Much
videos.description: A 1513 map appears to show Antarctica — 300 years before it was discovered. Coincidence? 🗺️ New wonder every day.
videos.thumbnail: Aged map with a glowing southern coast; "300 YEARS TOO EARLY."

videos.topic: How deep can we actually dig?
videos.title: How Deep Have Humans Actually Dug?
videos.description: The deepest hole on Earth got so hot the rock turned soft. And we barely scratched the surface. 🕳️ New wonder every day.
videos.thumbnail: Cross-section of a borehole into glowing-hot rock; "7.5 MILES DOWN."

videos.topic: What's the last sound you'd hear on the Moon?
videos.title: What Silence Sounds Like on the Moon
videos.description: You could shout on the Moon and hear nothing. It's a world of perfect, permanent silence. 🌕 New wonder every day.
videos.thumbnail: Lone footprint on the Moon, muted symbol; "PERFECT SILENCE."
